dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mind telling me a bit about yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: This island is my hometown. My whole family has been fishermen for generations. Naturally, I am a fisherman myself as well.

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: Due to the Sakoku Decree limiting our ability to go out to sea, we fishermen temporarily became a rare sight indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: But those problems are all in the past now! The Sakoku Decree's gone for good — not only have the restrictions on fishing been lifted, but our Ritou clientele's grown, too!

dialogues.speaker: Obata
dialogues.text: It's time! I shall once again answer the call of the ocean, hahaha!
